sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's smooth controls make it easy to maneuver your vehicles, but the increasing difficulty will require you to think strategically and plan your moves carefully. You'll have to consider the size and shape of each vehicle, as well as the space available to park them.
 
One of the key features of Parking Puzzle Escape Challenge is its ability to adapt to the player's skill level. The game will adjust its difficulty to keep you challenged, but not frustrated.
